user_confirmed_rules: EMA20 above EMA200 defines LONG direction; EMA20 below EMA200 defines SHORT direction
every separate EMA200 touch remains valid until EMA20 crosses back to the opposite side
a wick-only EMA200 touch is valid
consecutive touching bars are one touch episode; a later touch after at least one non-touch bar is another valid setup
entry requires an M5 close beyond the diagonal or neckline and executes at the next M5 open
A-B is the prior trend impulse and TP is N-wave equality AB=CD
stop is 30 pips beyond C; under the BTC contract 30 pips equals a $300 price distance
skip when net reward is below 50 pips
reward-to-risk is strictly greater than 1 and strictly less than 3

methods: two confirmed pivots forming the counter-trend diagonal
three-or-more-pivot regression line with R-squared at least 0.70
double-top or double-bottom neckline with peak/trough difference at most 0.25 ATR14
